alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

logs: EVENT Killing Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh: Container checkout failed liveness probe, will be restarted
EVENT Killing Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8: Container checkout failed liveness probe, will be restarted
EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8_warden-pg(<UUID_1>)
EVENT Unhealthy Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh: Liveness probe failed:
EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh_warden-pg(<UUID_2>)
EVENT Unhealthy Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8: Liveness probe failed:

root_cause.hypothesis: Deploy at 13:42:45 pinned image python:3.12.7-alpine (from floating python:3.12-alpine) coincides with crashloop start. Low memory_limit_mib (48) likely too tight for new image's startup footprint, causing slow/throttled init that misses liveness probe deadline before container reports healthy — pod gets killed mid-startup, restarts, repeats. Logs show container DOES reach 'started, healthy' + heartbeat ok shortly after probe kills, consistent with borderline-slow startup racing a tight liveness timeout under memory pressure, not app logic failure.
evidence: Deploy revision 10 (image pin change) timestamp 13:42:45Z immediately precedes probe failures/restarts
restart_count=12, crashloop_containers=1, pods_ready=1/2 — one pod stuck in BackOff loop
memory_limit_mib=48 is very low for a Python alpine base image
Logs show liveness probe failures + BackOff for both pods, yet later 'started, healthy' and 'heartbeat ok' lines exist — container does eventually come up
oom_killed_containers=0.0 — no confirmed kernel OOM kill event recorded
ruled_out: Hard OOM-kill by kernel (oom_killed_containers metric is 0, though memory pressure short of OOM kill still possible)
App-level crash/exception — no error/exception lines in logs, only probe-triggered kills and healthy heartbeats

proposal.reasoning: Crashloop started right after deploy pinning image to python:3.12.7-alpine w/ low memory_limit_mib=48. Startup footprint of new image races liveness probe under mem pressure, pod killed mid-init, repeats. Root cause = deploy, not runtime fluke. Rollback restores prior working image.
proposal.expected_effect: checkout pods stop crashlooping, restart_count stabilizes, pods_ready returns to 2/2.
